info.title: Baltiyskiy Bereg Backend API
info.description: Backend API for the Baltiyskiy Bereg service-desk assistant. It exposes admin endpoints for dashboards and support operators, plus public client endpoints shared by the web flow and Telegram bot.

post.description: Authenticate an admin user and return a bearer token for protected endpoints.

get.description: Return the authenticated admin identity resolved from the bearer token.
Return top-level health and support efficiency metrics for the selected time period.
Return aggregated message activity buckets for the selected time period.
Return appeals filtered by date range, scope, and status for the admin queue.
Return a single appeal with its current status and timestamps.

post.description: Assign the appeal to the current admin and move it into in-progress state.
Mark the appeal as closed and return its closure timestamp.
Mark that the appeal customer satisfaction request has been sent.

get.description: Return the current assistant runtime settings used by the admin panel and backend orchestration.

put.description: Persist assistant runtime settings such as tone of voice, confidence threshold, and top-k retrieval.

post.description: Create a client account for the public request flow and return a bearer token.
Authenticate a client user and optionally link the current Telegram account.
Issue a client JWT for a Telegram user already linked to a backend account.

get.description: Return the authenticated client profile resolved from the bearer token.

post.description: Create a new client request with the selected source channel.

get.description: List requests created by the authenticated client, optionally filtered by channel.
Return one authenticated client request together with its message timeline.

post.description: Append a new client message to an existing request owned by the authenticated user.
